_comment: Single source of truth for every price, the launch end date and every build time on the site. build.py reads this file; pages never contain a price. Amounts are whole US dollars, printed with symbol, thousands and decimals below. After launch_end, the build renders standard prices only and drops the launch label and strike-through. Totals are never written here: pack prices and quotes are worked out from these rules, the same way in build.py and in pricing.js.
_launch: The launch block (Services, home, /start). The build adds the end date to the title and 'Prices go up on <the day after launch_end>' to the reason. After launch_end the block is not rendered at all.

launch.title: Launch pricing
launch.reason: We're new. Our first clients become our references, so they get our lowest prices.

_days: Build times are per tier (days), shown as: Ready in under N days, once we have your details.
_rules: The first system you pick is at its full price. Each further system is at its bundle rate (the same amount in the launch period and after it), or at the related add-on rate when it builds on one you're already paying for. Setups are at their own price, or the setup add-on rate alongside a related system. An add-on always rides on a system you're paying for that costs at least as much on its own, never on another add-on or on a setup. A service marked never_addon (the website) is always a main build.
_tier_label: label and from are how a tier is named in the launch block's price list.
_addon: Add-on rates, written out for both periods like the bundle rates.
_related: Pairs that share groundwork, so the second one costs the add-on rate. Pairs of two systems work either way round. A setup pairs with the systems listed beside it.
_packs: Named combinations the bundle builder suggests. Their prices are worked out from the rules above, never written down.
_custom: From this many services (unless the selection is exactly one of the packs above) the price is custom: the running total is shown as a ceiling ('Your price will be under ...'), never as a total, with this block and a Book a call button beside it.

custom.title: Need 3 or more?
custom.text: You get one custom price for the whole set — almost always lower than adding them up. Pay for exactly what your business needs. We set it together on a 15-minute call.
custom.short: One custom price for the whole set, almost always lower than adding them up. We set it together on a 15-minute call.

included_year_one: Small changes and fixes (text, prices, hours, photos)
_editions: The three 3D editions, their own top-level section on /services/. They are not services: they never enter the bundle, packs or calculator. Strings may hold {price}, {deposit}, {balance}, {kit_value} and {kit_standalone}, filled by build.py from the numbers beside them. badge is shown in the launch period, badge_after and cta_after after launch_end (cta_after falls back to cta). When launch equals standard no strike-through is shown.
